profile.headline: Software Engineer III
profile.summary: I've become a resourceful developer, delivering reliable, efficient and secure software solutions in ever changing environments. I'm not afraid of challenges. Whenever new knowledge is needed I invest my time to learn and step up my expertise so I can address the current situation and beyond. I love coding and as I grow in my career path I want to keep making impact using my expertise.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software and Infrastructure Developer Leader for Whole Foods inventory and employee team. Converted original WFM systems into the AWS infrastructure. Using Typescript and AWS CDK to setup the new infrastructure inside Amazon internal ecosystem. 

Major code refactoring bringing C# and PERL services into Java, with proper design patterns and modern frameworks like Spring Boot. Reduced redundancy by 70% and introduced Unit and Integration Testing to achieve code quality. 

Developer of new REST API endpoints for consuming Employee metadata. Leader of the infrastructure setup API definitions, implementation and proper Observability instruments to monitor every aspect of the APIS providing a replicable framework for future APIs

SQL query optimizing with indexing and replication strategies, that reduced query time from hours to minutes.

System designer of other projects within the team. Main participant of task breakdown and task sizing meetings providing valuable feedback.

Distinguished Code Reviewer and team collaborator, always ready to help and seek help from team members helping with CRs, design feedback, frameworks, how tos, etc.

positions.title: SDE II
positions.description:
Software Developer on Alexa Privacy Team, Using React, Typescript for frontend development and Java, Python, AWS SDK, Typescript, Ruby and AWS CDK for backend.

Member of the team that provided a control plane for ML scientists to share data resources (S3, DynamoDB, APIs, RDS instances, etc) with other teams with security and granularity required per use case.

Oncall collaborator, provided assistance to customer and systems issues. Monitored dashboards, alarms and tickets documenting findings and unblocking issues. Diving deep to find root cause and implement long term solutions or set up Tickets to keep track and share those issues with the team as a call to action.

Away team collaborator, from library updates to use the new permissions vending system, to part of the war room style development teams to implement cross team products on the organization. Contributor to features and service packages that became part of the bigger picture of the organization.

Implemented new APIs within the core system of the team, end to end, from requirements gathering with customers (Natural Language Engineers) till launch of the features and support to customers.

Producer of Observability package that became a framework for new systems to avoid repeating the common setup.

Code reviewer involved in 80% of the code reviews of the team.

Learnings:
* Non-technical communication skills with Stake holders.
* New communication channels to track progress, issues and news.
* Improved tasks sizing and execution/ self unblocking/ call to action within the team.
* Internal security  reassessments.
* Launch Announcements and post launch support.

AWS CDK infrastructure expertise:

IAM, Route53, CloudFront,  Lambda, ECS Fargate, BatchJobs, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3,            
RDS, StepFunctions, SNS, SQS, Cognito, CloudWatch, EventBridge
